capabilities: Render :shortcode: text as custom emoji images while typing
Suggest emoji via a fuzzy-matched autocomplete popup
Load emoji images from a configurable folder in the vault
Treat rendered emoji as a single unit for cursor and backspace
Configure render mode, image height, and folder rescans
disambiguation: Not an icon management system; it only renders colon-wrapped shortcodes as vault images, with no icon packs, pickers, or remote images.
extras: The README warns not to run it alongside other plugins using the same :shortcode: syntax (Icon Shortcodes, Emoji Shortcodes), since they compete over the same colon-wrapped text.
intentEvidence: Icon Shortcodes and similar plugins do far more than that (icon packs, pickers, a bunch of settings)
motivation: The author wanted the same Discord/Slack emote workflow in Obsidian and found existing icon plugins too complex and lacking polish for that simple use case.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type colon-wrapped shortcodes that render as your own custom emoji images, and existing icon plugins are heavier than needed for that single job.
